Info

Defines parameter dataclass encapsulating dependencies for NumericalPlanarKinematicsSolver.

class scaralang.core.service.kinematics.solver.numerical.planar.dependencies.NumericalPlanarDependencies(*, jacobian_calculator: IJacobianCalculator, planar_solver: IPlanarKinematicsSolver, config: DlsConfig)[source]¶

Bases: object

Parameter dataclass encapsulating dependencies for NumericalPlanarKinematicsSolver.

It defines:

attributes:
jacobian_calculator - Injected IJacobianCalculator protocol collaborator.
planar_solver - Injected IPlanarKinematicsSolver protocol collaborator.
config - Injected DlsConfig domain configuration model.
